messages:
jess_partnerships: Noticed recurring confusion across partners about who opens the war room and who owns customer comms. Can we agree a tiny, deterministic ladder?

tim_oncall: Yes. Proposed ladder: 1) Post in #partner-sev-hub (shared). 2) Run /summon-partner <org> to create private bridge + inject checklist. 3) Owner must be declared in the first 8m or default claim goes to oncall.

ananya_sre: Add configurable TTL per partner (default 8m) and an automatic escalation to SRE lead at 25m. Also require the first post to include: severity (P0/P1), affected listing/customer ID, and a single public ticket stub.

kevin_si: From SI side: we need a stable channel name we can wire into our automation and a required "relay contact: <email>" field so we can loop our comms engine. We can't share internal links.

bridge_bot: /summon-partner accepted 1 - bridge created: #bridge-sev-2167890123-acme. Zoom: https://meet.redwood/bridge-2167890123. Triage checklist injected. Notifying @tim_oncall, @kevin_si. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/partnerships/partner-sev-ladder

jess_partnerships: Handback must be explicit: remediation summary, artifacts (logs/config diffs), SI validation rows, and the confirmation line that the SI will close their ticket. Bot should auto-generate the handback template on resolve.

tim_oncall: Next steps: Tim to add /summon-partner template to bridge_bot (ETA 48h). Ananya to update runbook with partner TTL overrides (ETA EOW). Kevin to share SI relay format + sample public ticket stub (ETA 48h). I'll run a tabletop with three partners next week.

ananya_sre: I'll also add a short public-status snippet the bot posts that partners can copy to their status pages.

kevin_si: We'll join the tabletop and validate automation. Thanks all.

bridge_bot: Reminder set: "Partner SEV tabletop" in 7 days.
